brief.headline: Cut laminate price by 77% to ₹250/kg — our current ₹1067.36/kg is 4× both market fair price (₹250/kg) and Silk Polypack's rate

priceAsk.basis: We pay ₹1067.36/kg; Silk Polypack charges ₹250/kg for the same item (326.9% gap). The open-market asking band for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg — so our current price is way above fair. The import floor for BOPET film is 171.60 ₹/kg, meaning even the raw substrate costs far less than what we're paying for finished laminate.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep payment at 30 days — no change

brief.financialLeverage: Huhtamaki is financially healthy — they make ₹2755.75 Cr in sales and keep 4.7% as profit, with very low debt (0.11x) and decent returns (12.0%). But we are tiny to them: our ₹76850 is 0.00% of their revenue, so on our own we have almost no pull. The good news is they're growing fast (23.1% a year), so they want new orders. Bundle more volume or a longer commitment, and dangle UFLEX or Constantia Parikh as ready second sources — that combination gives us the room to push hard on this huge price gap.

evidence.point: Our laminate price is 4× what Silk Polypack charges and 4× the top of the market fair band
Market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg
Even the raw BOPET film substrate imports at far less than what we pay for finished laminate
Closing this price gap saves us ₹58850 every year
We are microscopic to them — our spend is 0.00% of their ₹2755.75 Cr revenue
They are growing sales fast and want volume

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant (₹16492.00 Cr revenue) that makes both film and converts laminate — can supply finished sachets at scale and benchmark our price

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global group's India arm specializing in pharma blister and sachet laminates (₹222.04 Cr revenue) — a strong second source for our laminate sachets

risks: We're 0.00% of their sales, so alone we have little leverage — must bundle volume, lock in a longer term, or credibly threaten to move business to UFLEX or Constantia

Huhtamaki may argue their laminate has a pharma-grade spec or customization that justifies the premium — ask for the spec sheet and cost breakdown, then benchmark each layer against the import substrate price (171.60 ₹/kg) and the market band (₹205–305/kg)
If they won't move much on price, qualify UFLEX and Constantia Parikh immediately and run a parallel RFQ — real competition will force the issue
Their health score is only C (58/100) and debt is low (0.11x), but fast growth (23.1%) can mask cash pressure — watch for any hint they need our order, and use it
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to continue with you, but right now we're paying ₹1067 per kilo when the market fair price for this laminate is ₹250 — help us understand the gap and let's work toward that benchmark.
